verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server applies. It documents a first-party hosted server at https://mcp.skyfire.xyz/mcp, plus a sandbox endpoint, authenticated with the skyfire-api-key header. Named tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token) let a connected agent discover sellers and create tokens. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoint works as documented (the runtime probe exercised only the token REST API).
